'''Caliban''' was a weapons manufacturer based on [[Calabosh-2]]. Caliban was eventually [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalized]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when it was found they were intentionally marketing their products to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and other insurrectionists during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]], a major weapons and equipment manufacturer for the Empire, received most of Caliban's assets. [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] later bought the design for the [[Model X/Legends|Model X]] [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], using it for the basis of their [["Renegade" heavy blaster pistol/Legends|Renegade heavy blaster pistol]].
